_about: A style may bring its own colours (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-16: "A style may bring in its own colours and theming as long as it doesn't end up looking like a clown's apron. I want to experiment with variety, colour, and visual styles. We're in the experimental stage of content creation here, as opposed to being obsessive about brand guidelines."). A piece names one in its spec (style.palette); compile draws the cut in it and keeps his brand marks (the mark tile, the series pill, the call card, the ending) in the house colours of config/studio.json. Each palette fills the five colour roles the devices read (config/ve/brand-tokens.json), so a spec still names roles, never colours: ink the ground, ink_deep and ink_soft its shades, cream the type and paper, mint the one accent. Five colours, no more, and scripts/velib/palettes.py holds the contrast (no clown's apron). 'suits' names the styles each was made for; any piece may try any palette.
